endorsements.name: Scott Fretheim
endorsements.label: Do-It-Yourself Cellular IDS
endorsements.description: For less than $500, you can build your own cellular intrusion detection system to detect malicious activity through your own local femtocell. Our team will show how we leveraged root access on a femtocell, reverse engineered the activation process, and turned it into a proof-of-concept cellular network intrusion monitoring system.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2013

endorsements.label: Network Forensics: Sudden Death Workshop
